envelope.description: Pin lmdb's transaction behaviour and the store's open options

body.title: Pin lmdb's transaction behaviour and the store's open options
body.summary: New src/db/graph/__tests__/lmdb-txn-semantics.test.ts: in a fresh process after a reopen (the store-child.ts harness or a direct child), root.transaction keeps a throwing callback's write, root.childTransaction and root.transactionSync discard it. A test that the store opens without useWritemap (child transactions available). lock-loss-detection.test.ts and lock-loss-reproduction.test.ts pass unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: The pin test fails if lmdb starts discarding root.transaction writes or keeping childTransaction ones

tests.name: src/db/graph/__tests__/lmdb-txn-semantics.test.ts: in a fresh process after a reopen, root.transaction keeps a throwing callback's write, childTransaction and transactionSync discard it; the store opens without useWritemap
